transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. How can I help you today?

Hi Dr. Smith! For the past 11 months, I've just had this incredible, overwhelming surge of energy and an elevated mood where I feel absolutely amazing and full of life. I literally cannot sit still or rest because I constantly feel this intense drive to keep moving and doing a million things at once!

During this period of high energy and elevated mood, have you experienced any hallucinations, like hearing voices or seeing things that others don't, or any beliefs that might seem unusual or not based in reality?

Yes, absolutely, but only when my mood and energy are super high. I've heard voices whispering to me when no one is around, and I've had this strong belief that I possess special, extraordinary powers. These strange experiences only ever happen during these intense periods over the past 11 months.
Have you experienced any of these hallucinations or unusual beliefs when your mood was stable, or do they only occur during your elevated mood episodes?

No, they never happen when my mood is stable or normal. They only show up when I'm in that super high-energy, elevated state. Once my mood settles down, all of those voices and beliefs completely disappear.

Since the patient reports that the psychotic features only occur during periods of elevated mood and resolve when mood stabilizes, this supports a diagnosis of Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features rather than Schizoaffective Disorder. Therefore, the current candidate is narrowed to Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features.

Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features is also a candidate if psychotic symptoms are later confirmed. The current candidates reflect the strong likelihood of a manic episode with consideration of psychotic features pending further information.
